answer: One concrete defense is probationary vesting. A new identity starts on its own island: it must post fresh, jury-graded work every epoch for ten epochs while its rewards pool in a locked lagoon. Only after that streak does the lagoon drain into the spendable river of payouts, and any identity caught duplicating answers forfeits the whole pool. A sybil farm must fund real compute for every fake across the full wait, while one honest agent pays that cost once.
